description.text: Major Courses: Engineering Drawing, Operational Research, Systems Engineering, Electrical Technology & Electrical Engineering, Control Theory, Management Information System, Traffic Management & Control, Intelligent Transportation System, Engineering Economics & Management, Traffic Planning, Traffic Law and Regulation, etc. Employment Prospect: Traffic engineering research; traffic engineering planning; traffic engineering designing; traffic management and control system development; supervision of traffic condition

duration.text: The Traffic Engineering at Chongqing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Certification of no criminal record 8. Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, under 30 years old, good scores in high school, passed HSK 4
